title: Origin-bound read-only SWAP management demand receipt
problem: Real Ribasim allocation must receive SWAP demand before allocation and physical realization. The qualified RM06 transaction currently derives demand inside the later candidate advance, so a separate read-only demand stage is required to preserve causal ordering.
frozen_causal_order: real Ribasim management request and allocation
requirements: Demand derivation may not mutate accepted irrigation or Rutter continuation.
The receipt is bound to management lineage, management revision, crop-origin revision and management interval.
The receipt uses the same admitted TCS1/DCS2 evaluator as the later RM06 transaction; no second trigger physics is introduced.
A split-required irrigation event is evaluated only to its exact event end, matching RM06.
Same origin plus same immutable request produces bit-identical receipts.
No-event demand is a valid zero request, not an error.
An active irrigation event at the accepted origin remains outside the first management-coupling profile and fails closed.
No allocation or supplied quantity enters demand derivation.
falsification_conditions: Replay from the same origin changes receipt identity.
The receipt request differs from the request recomputed by RM06 for the same origin.
Allocation or physical-supply state is needed to determine the receipt.
nonclaims: RM07 does not admit partial irrigation.
RM07 does not commit Richards hydrology.
RM07 does not change TCS1/DCS2 physics.
